_comment: All fictional data. event.start/end.utc accept a literal ISO string or a relative 'NOW±<N>h' token, resolved once at server startup relative to the instant the process started (see resolveDate() in server.js). Attendees are generated at startup (see genAttendees() in server.js): 120 fictional attendees, mostly 'attending', a few 'not-approved'/'cancelled' to exercise status filtering, one deliberately placed on page 3 (attendees 101-120) for the pagination test — see needleAttendee below.
